scope: Research binding candidates for8retained CV rooms, not an integrated portal or verification of actual room/floor/window. Source-based static geometry is exact to retained arrays, not surveyed reality. No provider pixels.
attribution: Building footprint facts derived from OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0; official/design source pages retain their own copyrights. No provider images shipped.

coordinateContract.xz: District source metres, x east/z south; registry anchor yaw describes authored model only.
coordinateContract.vertical: Null until root samples actual live source facade/ground geometry; room H/W/D and prepared generic heights are not external-world floor elevations.
coordinateContract.candidates: Every nonzero outer and retained courtyard edge is a geometric candidate, including short edges; no edge/window/floor selected. Actual emitted facade can have offsets/cornices/podiums.
coordinateContract.portalMath: Root must supply actual outer source-facade plane/corners in the existing live world and map actual Office.windowPane aperture/head motion into it. Clip near just outside that plane; math removes no source geometry.
coordinateContract.oneWorld: Render current existing district/time/weather/season/actors with same world. No panorama, proxy district, secondary simulation or actor thinning.

fallbackPolicy.selectionOwner: Root integration; no automatic fallback selection in this ledger/helper
fallbackPolicy.candidate: Explicitly declared estimated ground-facade live district view only after confirming retained source identity and actual emitted facade plane. It does not claim to be the real office window.
fallbackPolicy.label: Live district view · room floor/viewpoint not verified
fallbackPolicy.blockedIdentity: Do not select a current-office view from a known mismatched building (UiPath-Bucharest A/B) until resolved; retain exact district context separately if root chooses a visibly declared illustrative view.
fallbackPolicy.userClarification: Numbered floor + building/block + window side/landmark direction + approximate era; floor alone does not determine facade bearing.
fallbackPolicy.preservation: No window removal, facade hiding, world reconstruction, object relocation or weather/time substitution to improve view.
